content.title: The New York Times
content.text: Yazan K BaderGreatness knows no imitation! Ryan Coogler proves that originality is the path to immortality….after 10 years of patience a musical vampire film? This is not just a movie this is an artistic revolution!Congratulations to one of the most daring and creative directors of our generation. He truly deserved it!!!!!Brett A. SingerSinners gets off the mat, still has a shot at Best Picture, especially after the upset in Cinematography.6Alphonzo TurnerI’m actually happy things played out the way they did. If he had won most of the awards where’s the hunger to produce something better than sinners? “Show them up do it again.”2Sara KeddyThanks NYT for pointing out Sinners is R rated (just like OBAA) and that it's Coogler's "first film based on an original idea in 10 years" - I'm not sure what point you're trying to make here but whatever. I'm thrilled he won and I just wish this fantastic, beautiful, and yes highly original film won even more awards.17Robin Van LiewWhat a pleasure to finally enjoy the contributions of African Americans to cinema after they were barred for so longTiffani TaylorSpoiler alert. There's a delay. 2AvaKbg KbgI loved his speech.. so heartfelt and real15ErasmusI'll take What is DEI for , Alex.7
